title: The New York Times Company v. Microsoft Corporation and OpenAI Inc. Lawsuit Complaint
publisher: US District Court for the Southern District of New York
supports_claim: Lawsuit documents detailed examples where generative models outputted verbatim copies of copyrighted articles without licensing or credit.
limitations: Complaint represents legal allegations filed by plaintiff prior to final judicial verdict.

title: CNET Found Errors in More Than Half of Its AI-Written Stories
supports_claim: CNET issued major substantive corrections on 41 out of 77 automated articles due to basic mathematical and financial hallucinations.
limitations: News analysis based on public editorial corrections without access to internal prompts or model architecture.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
supports_claim: NIST provides core risk management guidelines covering validity reliability transparency and safety for generative AI.
limitations: Voluntary risk framework rather than enforceable regulatory directive.

title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Defines legal obligations for AI developers and deployers operating within Vietnam digital market.
limitations: Requires cross-referencing with specific sectoral circulars on digital media and copyright.

title: EU AI Act Generative AI and Transparency Obligations
supports_claim: Mandates watermarking and transparency disclosure for AI-generated synthetic content and respect for Union copyright law.
limitations: Harmonized implementation guidelines continue to evolve across EU member states.
